Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: of Hippo Augustine (author, Wikidata Q8018), died 430; Saint Possidius (author, Wikidata Q718003), died 437; Louis Ignace Moreau (translator, Wikidata Q28491099), died 1881. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Augustine, of Hippo, Saint, 354-430; Possidius, Saint, active 370-437; Moreau, Louis Ignace, 1807-1881 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Les confessions de Saint Augustin, évêque d'Hippone, Paris, E. Flammarion, 1900, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lesconfessionsde00augu_0. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 94%, 80%, 77% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of of Hippo Augustine, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
